scope: Retrospective, region-held-out tile benchmark; no prospective, complete-map, operational, or independent-validation claim.
primary_scientific_estimand: Exposure-matched change in target segmentation performance from pooled-source versus source-only replay placebo training.
primary_operational_estimand: None. Few-shot results are benchmark-level comparisons, not deployment-readiness estimates.

primary_test_population.source_only_benchmark: 4 architectures x 3 seeds x 6 independent held-out regions; source-adjacent Moxitaidi (980 tiles) is reported separately and excluded from held-out aggregates
primary_test_population.exposure_matched_source_expansion: Bottleneck-LiteASK x seeds 42/2026/777 x Hokkaido/Lombok/Palu x 1120 steps x batch 32 x 35840 exposures
primary_test_population.few_shot_adaptation: ResUNet x seeds 42/2026/777 x Hokkaido/Lombok/Palu x 20 support tiles x 400 steps; full fine-tuning primary, decoder-only secondary

pairing: All intervention contrasts are paired by seed, architecture, target region, and checkpoint budget.

uncertainty.method: cluster bootstrap paired at the level of target region and seed, with tile-cluster resampling added after eval-only tile outputs are available
uncertainty.region_weighting: equal weight across the prespecified target regions
uncertainty.tile_rule: tiles are resampled within region and seed clusters; pixels are never treated as independent observations

material_effect_rule.interpretation: Reporting marker on the bounded 0-1 IoU scale, not a deployment threshold. A headline claim also requires a positive or negative interval that excludes zero and directional consistency in at least one prevalence-robust co-primary endpoint.
material_effect_rule.legacy_rule: The old 0.02 statement in the manuscript is superseded and must be removed or reconciled.

confirmatory_rules: Confirmatory source-expansion claim; source-adjacent Moxitaidi cannot be treated as held-out is limited to the exact tested architecture, targets, budget, and treatment package.
A broad homogeneity or universal-transfer claim is prohibited.
Few-shot claims are limited to benchmark tiles and query-covered stitched maps.
Negative or failed replication results remain visible.
prohibited_claims: false-positive area or omitted area per complete event
independent validation language for the query split
native-resolution performance without a native-scale run
held-out or independent-region language for Moxitaidi
analysis_sequence: Recompute all endpoints from existing E1 and E4 raw JSON.
Run eval-only inference on existing checkpoints for tile-level metrics, ECE, Brier, and risk-coverage.
Publish the pooled-source composition and sampling weights.
Publish code, split manifests, metric code, logs, and machine-readable outputs.
Rewrite manuscript claims and limitations to match this frozen protocol.
Decide separately whether to run the optional all-region architecture and budget expansion.
source_adjacency_correction: Moxitaidi was moved from the held-out target set to a source-adjacent cross-GSD diagnostic after confirming that source training contains Moxi-town imagery from the same 2022.09-2022.10 acquisition. Held-out aggregates use six regions and 11,344 tiles.
